owns: end-to-end Book System architecture and behavior
Book-System-wide roadmap and primary next-step selection
acceptance of child-project outputs into the Book System

child_projects.purpose: Build, qualify and evolve prose intelligence, drafting, diagnosis, revision, comparison and craft-reference capabilities for eventual controlled use by the Book System.

scope_rules: The Book System and Prose Project are distinct project identities.
The Prose Project is subordinate to and built for the Book System.
A Prose Project critical path or blocker is not automatically the Book System critical path or blocker.
The Book System decides whether and how qualified Prose capabilities are admitted or integrated.
Component, workflow, qualification, branch and chat labels cannot silently redefine this hierarchy.
Historical implementation names remain evidence labels and do not create new parent projects.
